z-m-38-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ngaphandle kokwahlula ngophawu kuqala, ndachaza ngokwahlula kwimeko apho k yeyona inkulu nemeko apho k yeyona incinci.

z-m-38-05.title: Ukuba siphindaphinda imisebenzi emibini enyukayo, isiphumo sihlala sinyuka nasona?
z-m-38-05.topic: Imisebenzi enyukayo neziphumo: ukwakha imizekelo echasayo ngeziphumo zemisebenzi yomgca, nemiqathango apho ibango libamba khona
z-m-38-05.goal: Vavanya ibango "isiphumo semisebenzi emibini enyukayo siyanyuka," yakha imizekelo echasayo eyahlukileyo usebenzisa imisebenzi yomgca, uze ukhethe imiqathango apho ibango libamba khona.
z-m-38-05.material: Kukho imisebenzi emibini f no-g onke amanani anyanisekileyo yidomeyini yayo. "Inyukayo" ithetha ukuba ukuba x₁ < x₂, ngoko f(x₁) < f(x₂). USeoa wathi, "Ukuba f no-g zombini ziyimisebenzi enyukayo, ngoko isiphumo h(x) = f(x)·g(x) naso ngumsebenzi onyukayo." USeoa wathatha f(x) = x + 1 no-g(x) = 2x + 1 wabala h kwi-x = 1, 2, 3. h(1) = 6, h(2) = 15, h(3) = 28.
z-m-38-05.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa imizekelo echasayo ukucoca nokukhetha imiqathango apho ibamba khona
z-m-38-05.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yokuba umsebenzi uyanyuka (ukuba x₁<x₂, ngoko f(x₁)<f(x₂))
z-m-38-05.prereq.2: Ukubala amaxabiso emisebenzi yomgca nesiphumo sawo (x+m)(x+n)
z-m-38-05.prereq.3: Inyaniso yokuba umzekelo o-1 ochasayo wanele ukubonisa ukuba ibango libubuxoki
z-m-38-05.s.s1.prompt: Ujonga ukubala kukaSeoa, yintoni efanelekileyo kakhulu ukuyithetha ngebango likaSeoa?
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phantsi uluhlu lwe-x olwavavanywa nguSeoa, uze ulithelekise nedomeyini yonke.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kwi-f(x) = x + 1 kunye ne-g(x) = 2x + 1, fumana namaxabiso e-h xa x ingu-−3, −2, −1, 0.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.a: Amaxabiso e-h akhula ngokulandelelana kwi-x = 1, 2, 3, ngoko sithatha ibango njengeliyinyaniso
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.a: Wandise inyaniso yokuba amaxabiso amathathu akhule kuluhlu lonke lwedomeyini. Ukuze umsebenzi unyuke, kufuneka ubambe kuzo zonke x₁<x₂.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.b: Kuba zombini f no-g ziyanyuka, kulandela ngokuthe ngqo ukuba imveliso iyanyuka, ngoko akukho kuhlola kufunekayo
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.b: Wamkele ibango endaweni yokuliphatha njengento ekufuneka ihlolwe. Ngokungafaniyo nesixa, imveliso ichatshazelwa ziimpawu.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.c: Amaxabiso e-x avavanyiweyo asengangamanani ase-positive kuphela, ngoko kunzima ukuthi iyinyaniso phambi kokubona amaxabiso asecaleni elingaphantsi kwe-0 nawo
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo sahlula uluhlu olwavavanywayo kuluhlu lonke lwedomeyini sigqibe ukuba kuvavanywe phi ngakumbi.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.o.d: Amaxabiso akhula ngokukhawuleza, njenge-h(3)=28, ngoko singathi imveliso iyanyuka
z-m-38-05.s.s1.r.d: Unikele ingqalelo ekukhuleni kwamaxabiso. Oko ibango likuthethayo akuphathelelanga nobukhulu bokukhula kodwa kunyuka kuyo yonke x.
z-m-38-05.s.s1.explain: Kwi-x = −3, −2, −1, 0, h yi-10, 3, 0, 1. Ukusuka ku-x = −3 ukuya ku-−2, h iyehla ukusuka kwi-10 ukuya kwi-3. Umzekelo kaSeoa uvavanye icala le-positive kuphela, ngoko singazange sikwazi ukuxela ukuba ibango liyinyaniso, kwaye enyanisweni ibango liyaphuka nakule mizekelo.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.prompt: f(x) = x + m kunye ne-g(x) = x + n (m ≤ n) zombini ngemisebenzi enyukayo. Ngoku yakha imizekelo apho imveliso h(x) = f(x)·g(x) ingenyuki. Oko kukuthi, yenza h(p) > h(q) kumanani amabini ap<q. Yenza imizekelo emi-3 ene-(m, n) eyahlukileyo.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.0: Emva kokukhetha m no-n, yenza itheyibhile yamaxabiso e-h(x) kwi-x = −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 ukhangele indawo apho amaxabiso ehla khona.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.hint.1: Xa ufumana indawo apho amaxabiso ehla khona, bhala la maxabiso e-x amabini njenge-p ne-q. Tshintsha m no-n uvavanye ukuba ezinye (m, n) zinayo indawo apho amaxabiso ehla khona nazo.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m ayikhulu kune-n (ukuze isibini somsebenzi esifanayo singabalwa kabini kwakutshintshiswa nje amagama).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda wenze m ≤ n (ukuze umzekelo ofanayo ne-f no-g zitshintshisiwe ungabalwa kabini).
z-m-38-05.s.s2.ok.c3: p < q kodwa h(p) > h(q). h ayinyuki.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.fail.c3: h(p) ayikhulu kune-h(q). Bala wena indlela ixabiso lemveliso elitshintsha ngayo.
z-m-38-05.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba f(x) = g(x) = x (m = n = 0), ngoko h(x) = x² kwaye h(−2) = 4 > h(−1) = 1. Ukuba f(x) = x + 1 kunye ne-g(x) = x + 3 (m = 1, n = 3), ngoko h(−3) = (−2)(0) = 0 > h(−2) = (−1)(1) = −1. Umzekelo omnye ochasayo wanele ukuphula ibango. Apho amaxabiso eentetho ezimbini ezilayinini engaphantsi kwe-0, ubukhulu bemveliso bunokuncipha njengoko x inyuka.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.prompt: Sifuna ukongeza imeko ukuze ibango likaSeoa lihlale libamba. Yeyiphi imeko efanelekileyo?
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kwimeko nganye, vavanya ukuba ungakha isibini somsebenzi esanelisa imeko kodwa imveliso yaso ingenyuki.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuthelekisa f(p)g(p) no-f(q)g(q) xa p < q, cinga ukuba amanani aphindaphinda f(p) < f(q) no-g(p) < g(q) kufuneka abe noluphi uphawu.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.a: Iigrafu ze-f no-g zombini zidlula kwindawo ye-origin kwaye zinyuka zijonge phezulu ekunene
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.a: f(x) = g(x) = x ngumsebenzi onyukayo odlula kwindawo ye-origin, kodwa h(x) = x² iyehla kwi-x < 0. Awuzange wakhe umzekelo ochasayo ukuvavanya.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.b: Amaxabiso omsebenzi f(0) no-g(0) kwi-x = 0 zombini zi-positive
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.b: Uphosise ukuba ingaba yi-positive kwi-x = 0 kuphela kwaye ibe yi-negative kwezinye x. Vavanya nge-f(x) = g(x) = x + 1 kwi-x = −3, −2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.c: Cinga ngedomeyini ncitshiswe yaya enxalenyeni apho x > 0
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.c: Nokuba idomeyini i-positive, amaxabiso omsebenzi anokuba ne-negative. Vavanya nge-f(x) = g(x) = x − 5 kwi-x = 1, 2.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.o.d: Kwi-x nganye kwidomeyini, f(x) no-g(x) zombini zi-positive
z-m-38-05.s.s3.r.d: Olu khetho lwahlula idomeyini kumaxabiso omsebenzi kwaye luqonda ukuba iimpawu zamanani aphindaphindwayo ziyabalulekile xa kuthelekiswa iimveliso.
z-m-38-05.s.s3.explain: Ukuba p < q, ngoko 0 < f(p) < f(q) kunye no-0 < g(p) < g(q), ngoko f(p)g(p) < f(q)g(p) < f(q)g(q). Umzekelo ochasayo we-a yi-f = g = x (h yi-4, 1 kwi-x = −2, −1), umzekelo ochasayo we-b yi-f = g = x + 1 (h yi-4, 1 kwi-x = −3, −2), kwaye umzekelo ochasayo we-c yi-f = g = x − 5 (h yi-16, 9 kwi-x = 1, 2).

z-m-38-01.title: Njengoko siwandisa umhlaba, ubuninzi nobuncinane bunyuka njani?
z-m-38-01.topic: Ubuninzi nobuncinane bomsebenzi we-quadratic xa umhlaba utshintsha
z-m-38-01.goal: Njengoko isiphelo k somhlaba sitshintsha, jonga ngetheyibhile yamaxabiso ukuba indawo apho ubuninzi nobuncinane kwenzeka khona (i-vertex okanye isiphelo) itshintsha njani, uze uphinde uchaze uqikelelo lwakho lokuqala.
z-m-38-01.material: Nantsi umsebenzi we-quadratic f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 (funda: 'x isikwere ukususa 4x kongeza 3'). Misela umhlaba ube yi-0 ≤ x ≤ k (k linani lokwenyani lepositive), tshintsha k, uze ujonge ubuninzi nobuncinane be-f kuloo mhlaba. U-Seoyeon waqikelela: "Ukuba isithuba siba bubanzi, ubuncinane buba bubonakala buncinci kwaye ubuninzi buba bukhulu." Iitheyibhile zamaxabiso ziyavezwa enye ngexesha, inyathelo ngenyathelo.
z-m-38-01.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya uqikelelo usebenzisa iitheyibhile zamaxabiso njengobungqina
z-m-38-01.thinking.1: Gcina okanye uhlaziye isigqibo sakho njengoko ulwazi olutsha lufika
z-m-38-01.thinking.2: Yitsho, usebenzisa izithuba, ukuba isigqibo sitshintsha njani xa umqathango (umhlaba) utshintsha
z-m-38-01.prereq.0: I-H1 yalo msebenzi ligama lobunzima elabelwe kwimveliso kuphela; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibeka olu lwazi kwibanga 1 lesikolo esiphakamileyo. Cinga ukuba iimfuneko ezingezantsi sele zifundiwe.
z-m-38-01.prereq.1: Ukubhala kwakhona umsebenzi we-quadratic kwimilo y=a(x−p)²+q ukufumana i-vertex (ukugqibezela isikwere)
z-m-38-01.prereq.2: Imo yegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic nearxisi yayo yokulinganisa
z-m-38-01.prereq.3: Ukubala amaxabiso omsebenzi wena ukwenza itheyibhile yamaxabiso
z-m-38-01.s.s1.prompt: Iitheyibhile zamaxabiso ziyavezwa enye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, yenza isigqibo ngedatha ekhoyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, kwaye xa idatha elandelayo ivela, gcina okanye uhlaziye eso sigqibo. (Umhlaba usoloko ungu-0 ≤ x ≤ k.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ubhanxa bakwa-x no-f(x) kwitheyibhile eyavezwa, uze uphawule apho amaxabiso amancinci nawona makhulu kwenzeka khona.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.hint.1: Phinda ubhale f(x) kwimilo (x−□)²+□, uze ujonge ukuba i-x apho ixabiso elincinci kwenzeka khona kuloo milo ikwingaphakathi komhlaba.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Le yitheyibhile yamaxabiso ye-k = 1 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1). Xa x = 0, f = 3; xa x = 0.5, f = 1.25; xa x = 1, f = 0. Kolu luhlu ubuncinane bu-0 kwaye ubuninzi bu-3.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ukuba siqhubeka sinyusa k ngaphaya kwe-1, ucinga ukuba kuya kwenzeka ntoni kubuncinane? (Qikelela usebenzisa kuphela iitheyibhile nefomyula ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.)
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngeetheyibhile ezintathu kuphela, zombini a no-b ziqikelelo ezinokwenzeka. Ukuba ucinge ngemilo yefomyula (ivula phezulu), b ngokwemvelo; ukuba ujonge kuphela ithambeka lamaxabiso ancipha, ufumana a. Masivavanye ngetheyibhile elandelayo.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Njengoko k inyuka, ubuncinane buyaqhubeka bunciphe
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqhubekeke ngethambeka lamaxabiso ancipha kuphela. Umsebenzi we-quadratic utshintsha icala kwindawo ethile, ngoko kufuneka ujonge ukuba loo ndawo ikwingaphakathi kwesithuba.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Olu qikelelo luvela ekukhumbuleni ukuba igrafu ivula phezulu, ngoko inendawo esezantsi. Apho loo ndawo isezantsi ikhona kufuneka ijongwe ngetheyibhile.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Nokuba k yintoni, ubuncinane bahlala bu-0
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ujonge kuphela amaxabiso angaphakathi kwesithuba kwaye awucingi ngamaxabiso angaphandle kwaso. Xa isithuba sibanzi, amaxabiso amatsha e-x ayangena.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Le yitheyibhile yamaxabiso ye-k = 3 (0 ≤ x ≤ 3). Xa x = 1, f = 0; xa x = 2, f = −1; xa x = 3, f = 0. Kwakhona, xa x = 2.5, f = −0.75. Ubuncinane bu-−1.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ukuba sinyusa k ngakumbi, ukuya kwi-k = 5 okanye k = 10, kuya kwenzeka ntoni kubuncinane?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ekubeni f(x) = (x−2)² − 1, ixabiso eliphantsi kakhulu −1 lenzeka kwi-x = 2, kwaye kwi-x enkulu kune-2 amaxabiso anyuka kwakhona. Ngoko nanini na k ingu-2 okanye ngaphezulu, ubuncinane bufana, −1. Ukuba ukhethe a ekuqaleni, khomba ukuba yeyiphi itheyibhile etshintshe uqikelelo lwakho.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuqapheli ukuba amaxabiso anyuka kwakhona emva kokudlula x = 2. Thelekisa amaxabiso ngaphambi kwe-x = 2 nangoko emva kwayo kwitheyibhile.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Esi sigqibo sifunda kwitheyibhile ukuba ixabiso liphantsi kakhulu kwi-x = 2 kwaye linyuka emva koko.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Xa isithuba sibanzi, ubuncinane bunokuncipha okanye bahlale bunjalo; abunakukhula. Uphosile ukuba onke amaxabiso esithuba sangaphambili asaqukiwe xa isithuba sibanzi.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kwi-k = 4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 4): xa x = 0, f = 3, kwaye xa x = 4, f = 3, ngoko iziphelo ezimbini zinexabiso elifanayo. Ubuninzi bu-3. Xa siwandisa kwi-k = 5, f = 8 kwi-x = 5 iba bubuninzi obutsha.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uqikelelo luka-Seoyeon, "ukuba isithuba siba bubanzi, ubuninzi buba bukhulu" lufanele lulungiswe njani?
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwi-0 ≤ k ≤ 4, f(k) ≤ 3, ngoko ubuninzi yi-f(0) = 3, kwaye ukusuka kwi-k > 4, f(k) iba nkulu kune-3. Uqikelelo luka-Seoyeon lulunge kuphela xa k < 2 kubuncinane, kwaye kuphela xa k > 4 kubuninzi. Uluhlu apho lulunge khona luyahlulwa ngokuxhomekeke kumqathango (isithuba).
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ngokukhawuleza xa k inyuka, ubuninzi buyanyuka nabo, ngoko u-Seoyeon ulunge njengoko ethe
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awujongi ukuba ubuninzi bahlala bu-3 xa k = 3 no-k = 4. Kufuneka uthelekise ukuba amaxabiso amatsha e-x awongezelelweyo anika into enkulu kunobuninzi obukhoyo.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Nokuba k inyuka kangakanani, ubuninzi bahlala bu-3
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uphosile ukuba f(5) = 8 iyavela kwi-k = 5. Kufuneka ujonge ukuba ixabiso lesiphelo liqhubeka likhula na.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ide k ifike kwi-4 ubuninzi bahlala bu-3, kwaye bukhula kuphela emva kokuba k ingqithe kwi-4
z-m-38-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Esi sigqibo sithelekisa ukuba sesiphi kwiziphelo ezimbini, x = 0 no-x = k, esinexabiso elikhulu.
z-m-38-01.s.s1.reflect: Abanye baqikelele kuqala "ubuncinane buqhubeka buba buncinci" baza batshintsha ingqondo emva kokubona itheyibhile ngaphaya kwe-x = 2, kwaye abanye baqikelele "inokuyeka" bagcina olo qikelelo. Ngomgca omnye, yitsho ukuba yeyiphi itheyibhile etshintshe (okanye egcine) isigqibo sakho.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.prompt: Kumhlaba 0 ≤ x ≤ k, khetha k apho (ubuninzi) − (ubuncinane) = 4. (k linani lokwenyani lepositive.)
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwi-k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, lungelelanisa ubuninzi nobuncinane kwitheyibhile ufumane umahluko.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.hint.1: Phawula amaxabiso e-k kwitheyibhile apho umahluko ungu-4, uze uvavanye ukuba ufana kwi-k ephakathi (umzekelo 2.5 no-3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.a: Umahluko ungu-4 kuphela xa k = 4, kwaye hayi kuyo nayiphi enye k
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.a: Ujonge kuphela ukuba umahluko ungu-4 kwi-k = 4 kwaye awuzange uvavanye amaxabiso akufutshane nayo (umzekelo 3.5).
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.b: Umahluko ungu-4 kuphela xa k = 3, kwaye hayi kuyo nayiphi enye k

z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.c: Awuzange ujonge ukuba kwi-k = 5, ubuninzi bu-8 kwaye ubuncinane bu-−1, ngoko umahluko ngu-9.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.o.d: Umahluko ungu-4 kuyo yonke inani lokwenyani k elisuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-4
z-m-38-01.s.s2.r.d: Esi sigqibo sifumene uluhlu apho ubuncinane bahlala bu-−1 kwaye ubuninzi bahlala bu-3 kwisithuba.
z-m-38-01.s.s2.explain: Kwi-2 ≤ k ≤ 4, ubuncinane bu-−1 (kwi-x = 2) kwaye ubuninzi bu-3 (kwi-x = 0), ngoko umahluko ungu-4. Ukuba k < 2, ubuncinane bukhulu kune-−1, ngoko umahluko ungaphantsi kwe-4; ukuba k > 4, ubuninzi f(k) bukhulu kune-3, ngoko umahluko ungaphezulu kwe-4.

z-m-38-04.title: Ukuba iifomula ezi-2 zombini zihambelana neerekhodi ezintathu zonke, leyiphi esifanele sithembe?
z-m-38-04.topic: Ukukhetha ifomula ehambelana nedatha (ukuthelekisa ukulingana okuguqulelweyo nomsebenzi wekhwadrathi)
z-m-38-04.goal: Thelekisa iintlobo ezi-2 zeefomula ezidlula kumanqaku amathathu edatha afanayo, gqiba ukuba leyiphi ifomula ekufuneka uyithembe nokuba kangakanani usebenzisa uvavanyo olutsha nolwakhiwo lwemeko, uze uxele uluhlu apho uthemba khona.
z-m-38-04.material: Amanzi angama-12 L athulule ngokulinganayo kwiibhotile ezifanayo ezi-x (x linani eliphelele eli-positive), yaye isixa y (L) kwibhotile e-1 siyalinganiswa. Iirekhodi: ngebhotile e-1, 12 L; ngeebhotile ezi-2, 6 L; ngeebhotile ezi-3, 4 L. Abahlobo ababini baphakamisa iifomula. UJiwon: y = 12/x (ifundwa: '12 ihlulwe ngo-x'). UHyunwoo: y = 2x² − 12x + 22 (ifundwa: '2 x isikwere kuthabathwa 12x kudibanisa 22'). Amanzi awavuzi, yaye ahlulwa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwebhotile.
z-m-38-04.thinking.0: Ukubala wena ukuhlola ukuba idatha nemodeli ziyahambelana na
z-m-38-04.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuba ukholelwa kakhulu kangakanani xa ubungqina obutsha bufika
z-m-38-04.thinking.2: Ukwahlula oko kuhambelana nedatha koko kuhambelana nemeko
z-m-38-04.prereq.1: Ukufumana amaxabiso omsebenzi (ukufaka x kwifomula nokubala)
z-m-38-04.prereq.2: Ukufunda iifomula zomsebenzi wekhwadrathi nomsebenzi y=k/x
z-m-38-04.prereq.3: Ubudlelwane (inani leebhotile) × (isixa kwibhotile e-1) = isixa esipheleleyo
z-m-38-04.s.s1.prompt: Ujonga iirekhodi ezintathu ezingentla kuphela, khetha intetho efanelekileyo kakhulu.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka x = 1, 2, 3 kwifomula nganye kwezi mbini uze uthelekise neerekhodi kwitheyibhile.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ifomula edlula kumanqaku amathathu iyodwa na, okanye kunokubakho ezininzi.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.a: y=12/x ilula, ngoko ezi rekhodi zodwa zanele ukugqiba ukuba ifomula kaJiwon ilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise "ifomula ilula" ngokungathi bubungqina. Ukulula kunokuba sisizathu sokukholelwa, kodwa akumiselwa yidatha.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.b: y=2x²−12x+22 inezidibanisi zonke zamanani aphelele ngoko ichanekile ngakumbi, ngoko ifomula kaHyunwoo ilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.b: Ujonge ukuchaneka ekubonakaleni kwezidibanisi. Ukuba ifomula ihambelana nedatha kwaziwa kuphela ngokufaka amaxabiso.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.c: Zombini iifomula zihambelana neerekhodi ezintathu, ngoko ezi rekhodi zodwa azikwazi ukuxela ukuba leyiphi ilungile
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.c: Olu gwebo lwamkela ukuba xa iifomula ezi-2 zihambelana nedatha efanayo, idatha yodwa ayikwazi ukuzahlula.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.o.d: Ifomula edlula kumanqaku amathathu iyodwa, ngoko enye kwezi mbini kufuneka ibe nempazamo yokubala
z-m-38-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukholelwe ukuba ifomula edlula kumanqaku amathathu iyodwa. Nokuba umsebenzi wekhwadrathi udlula kumanqaku amathathu, uhlobo olwahlukileyo lwefomula lunokudlula kumanqaku afanayo.
z-m-38-04.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka x = 1, 2, 3 kunika 12, 6, 4 kuzo zombini iifomula, ehambelana neerekhodi. Ekubeni iifomula ezi-2 zihambelana nedatha efanayo, iirekhodi zodwa azikwazi ukuzahlula. Ukugqiba ukuba leyiphi ifomula ekufuneka uyithembe, udinga ezinye iziseko, ezinjengovavanyo olutsha okanye ulwakhiwo lwemeko.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.prompt: Ulwazi olutsha luyatyhilwa isiqwenga ngesiqwenga. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, gqiba ukuba ukholo lwakho kwiifomula ezi-2 lutshintsha njani.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka inani leebhotile x elityhilwayo kuzo zombini iifomula ukufumana amaxabiso aqikelelweyo wena, uze uwathelekise nexabiso elilinganisiweyo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.hint.1: Xa ixabiso elilinganisiweyo lahlukile kuqikelelo, cinga ngezinto ezimbini ezinokwenzeka: ifomula inokuba iphosakele, okanye ukulinganisa kunokuba kuphosakele.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.info: Sahlule amanzi kwiibhotile ezi-4 salinganisa isixa kwibhotile e-1: yayi-3 L.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.ask: Xa uthelekisa eli xabiso lilinganisiweyo noqikelelo lweefomula ezi-2, ugqiba ntoni ngeefomula ezi-2?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Ifomula kaJiwon iqikelela i-3 L kwi-x = 4, yaye eka-Hyunwoo iqikelela i-6 L. I-3 L elinganisiweyo ivumelana nefomula kaJiwon yaye yahluke kakhulu kuka-Hyunwoo. Kunengqiqo ukuthemba icala likaJiwon ngoko nangoko, yaye kunengqiqo nokulinganisa kanye ngenxa yokwenzeka kwempazamo yokulinganisa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.o.a: Ukulinganisa kusenokuba kuphosakele, ngoko linganisa kanye ngakumbi uze ugqibe
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Sisimo esinocoselelo: ungaxhumi esigqibeni ukusuka kuxabiso e-1 elilinganisiweyo, kodwa ufuna ukuhlola.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Olu gwebo luthemba ngakumbi leyo uqikelelo lwayo lwahluke ngaphantsi kwixabiso elilinganisiweyo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Olu gwebo alukhange luhlole ukuba yeyiphi ixabiso ifomula kaHyunwoo ekunika lona kwi-x = 4.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.info: Ngeebhotile ezi-6 yalinganisa i-2 L, yaye ngeebhotile ezili-12 yalinganisa i-1 L. (Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, iirekhodi ezi-5.)
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.ask: Yeyiphi indlela efanelekileyo yokuxela ukholo lwakho kwifomula kaJiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Njengoko idatha ikhula, ukholo lwakho kwifomula kaJiwon luyakhula. Kodwa iirekhodi ezi-5 zodwa azikwazi ukuqinisekisa x nganye. Ukuba kukho isizathu (ulwakhiwo lwemeko), ukholo lwakho lungenziwa lube lunye.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Zonke iirekhodi ezi-5 zazilungile, ngoko sinokugqiba ukuba ilungile kwi-x nganye eyinani eliphelele eli-positive
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Wolule "iirekhodi zazilungile amaxesha ama-5" kuzo zonke iimeko. Amaxabiso ka-x angalinganiswanga awakahlolwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Nokuba inani leerekhodi ezihambelanayo liyanda, ukholo lwethu aluzitshintshi kwaphela
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Oku akuthathi ngqalelo ukuba ulinganiso olutsha lubobungqina obukhomba kwicala elifanayo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Ukholo lwethu lukhulile kuba iirekhodi ezi-5 ziyahambelana, kodwa isizathu esahlukileyo sisafuneka ukuze ibambe kumaxabiso ka-x angalinganiswanga
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Olu gwebo luthi ubungqina buqinisa ukholo, kodwa isizathu siyafuneka ukwandisa kuzo zonke iimeko.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.info: Ukuba uphindaphinda inani leebhotile ngesixa kwibhotile e-1, uhlala ufumana isixa esipheleleyo se-12 L. Kungenxa yokuba amanzi awavuzi yaye ahlulwa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwebhotile.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ukwazi oku, ungathini ngefomula kaJiwon y = 12/x?
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.after: Ekubeni x·y = 12, y = 12/x ivela ngqo kwimeko, hayi kwiirekhodi. Ngoko singathi ibamba kuyo yonke x eyinani eliphelele eli-positive phantsi kokucinga "amanzi awavuzi yaye ahlulwa ngokulinganayo." Ukuba ukucinga kuphuka (ukuba amanzi aya kuvuza), ifomula nayo iyatshintsha.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Hayi kuba kweerekhodi kuphela kodwa ngenxa yolwakhiwo lwemeko, singathi y=12/x kuyo yonke x eyinani eliphelele eli-positive ukuba nje amanzi awavuzi yaye ahlulwa ngokulinganayo
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Olu gwebo lumisela uluhlu lokholo kusetyenziswa zombini izizathu kunye: ubungqina bedatha nolwakhiwo lwemeko.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Kusafuneka sithembele kwiirekhodi ezi-5 kuphela, yaye ulwakhiwo lwemeko asisiso siseko
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Waphosisa ukuba ubudlelwane obuvela kwimeko (isiphumo asitshintshi) bumisela ifomula ngqo.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Ifomula kaHyunwoo ngengozi idlula kumanqaku amathathu, ngoko ifomula kaJiwon iphosakele
z-m-38-04.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Ukuba ifomula kaHyunwoo idlula kumanqaku amathathu akuthethi ukuba ifomula kaJiwon iphosakele. Ifomula yakhe ayihambelani nolwakhiwo kumaxabiso amanye ka-x.
z-m-38-04.s.s2.reflect: Ku-s1 wagweba "asikwazi ukuzahlula," yaye abanye bayitshintsha emva kokubona ulinganiso lweebhotile ezi-4, ngoxa abanye bayigcina ngo"linganisa kanye ngakumbi." Yitsho ukuba isizathu sokuba ugwebo lwakho lutshintshe okanye lwahlala lwalixabiso elilinganisiweyo okanye ulwakhiwo lwemeko.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.prompt: UHyunwoo wathi, "Nangona kunjalo, umsebenzi wekhwadrathi wahambelana neerekhodi ezintathu, ngoko usenokulunga kamva." Chaza iziseko zokuba kutheni ifomula kaHyunwoo ingahambelani nale meko, usebenzisa ubuncinane inani e-1.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka x = 4, 6, 10, njalo njalo kwifomula kaHyunwoo ukufumana amaxabiso aqikelelweyo, uze uhlole ukuba ngamaxabiso anokwenzeka kwimeko yokwenyani na.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela isixa kwibhotile e-1 esifanele sitshintshe ngayo njengoko inani leebhotile likhula, nendlela ixabiso lefomula litshintsha ngayo.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Xa x = ..., ifomula kaHyunwoo inika ... L, kodwa ...
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba inani olinikileyo lixabiso olibale ngokufaka kwifomula kaHyunwoo?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uchaze ukuba kutheni eli xabiso lingahambelani nemeko (ukuba zikho iibhotile ezininzi isixa kufuneka sehle, asinakuba sikhulu kunesixa esipheleleyo, njalo njalo)?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uyiqonde wabhala ukuba kutheni "yahambelana namanqaku amathathu" ingeyonto eneleyo njengesiseko?
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.0: Xa x=4, ifomula kaHyunwoo inika i-6 L, kodwa sasilinganise ngokwenene i-3 L. Kwakhona, ayihambelani nemeko yokuba isixa kwibhotile e-1 siphinde sibe sikhulu emva kokuba iibhotile ziye zanda. Ngoko nangona ihambelana namanqaku amathathu, akufuneki sisebenzise le fomula.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba x=10, ifomula kaHyunwoo inika 2×100−120+22=102 L, engaphezu kwamanzi apheleleyo angama-12 L. Yahambelana neerekhodi ezintathu kodwa ayichanekanga kwamanye amaxabiso, ngoko ayinakuthenjwa.
z-m-38-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Le mpendulo isebenzisa ixabiso elingenakwenzeka kwimeko njengesiseko, endaweni yexabiso elilinganisiweyo.
